name: nepse-stock-website
description: NEPSE Stock Market Website - Production Deployment

scripts.install:all: npm ci && cd backend && npm ci && cd ../frontend && npm ci
scripts.start:prod: cd backend && pm2 start ecosystem.config.js --env production
scripts.test: cd backend && npm test && cd ../frontend && npm test
scripts.verify: cd backend && npm run verify && cd ../frontend && npm test -- --run && npm run build
scripts.verify:stable: npm run verify && cd backend && npm run stable
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run build:frontend
